producer_report.summary: I added one bullet to reader.md. When a request touches CI caching or CI speed, the reading must state in an acceptance criterion how the GitHub Actions cache is scoped by branch. The scoping it states: runs restore only from their own branch (or PR merge ref), base branch and the default branch, never sibling branches; feature-branch caches are invisible to the default branch and others. A new unit test checks that the reader prompt names this. To stay within the unchanged 2000-token budget I trimmed wording elsewhere in reader.md, keeping every phrase existing tests check. The reader set is now 1999 of 2000, so I updated the mirrored figure in docs/system-facts.md and docs/design/context-engineer.md and added a CHANGELOG entry. The athena-context, budgets, policy and mirrors tests pass. The full cargo test and clippy are left to Athena's checks.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-context/prompts/reader.md has a bullet saying that when a request touches CI caching or CI speed, the reading states how the GitHub Actions cache is scoped by branch and puts that constraint in an acceptance criterion.
criteria_check.evidence: First bullet under 'Reading the request' in reader.md: 'For CI caching or CI speed, state in an acceptance criterion how the GitHub Actions cache is scoped by branch: ...'.

criteria_check.criterion: The bullet states the scoping correctly: a run restores caches from its own branch (or PR merge ref), its base branch, and the default branch; it cannot restore caches from sibling or unrelated branches; caches saved by a feature branch are not visible to the default branch or other branches.
criteria_check.evidence: The bullet reads: runs restore only from their own branch (or PR merge ref), base branch and the default branch, never sibling branches; feature-branch caches are invisible to the default branch and others. It does not say 'unrelated' branches; 'only from' own/base/default covers that.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs asserts READER_FRAME.text names the CI cache, branch scoping, base/default branch and acceptance criterion. Run `cargo test -p athena-context`: it passes, and it would fail if the bullet were removed.
criteria_check.evidence: Test reader_names_the_github_actions_cache_branch_scoping_for_ci_work asserts five phrases from the bullet. It passes in cargo test -p athena-context (123 passed). The phrases appear only in the new bullet, so removing it fails the test.
